meta.title: The Founding Partner program — Mobilcab
meta.description: Join the Founding Partner waitlist: when we open paid Basic with M2 (design, cut lists, nesting, labels, quotes), you get a discount. Anyone who subscribes later pays full list price.

hero.label: The Founding Partner program
hero.title: Help shape the tool Romanian workshops actually need.
hero.body: We're not looking for testers for unfinished software. We're looking for workshops to build it with us. Join the Founding Partner waitlist for free; when we ship M2 and open paid Basic, people on that list get a discount. Anyone who subscribes later pays full list price.

counter.full: All {total} Founding Partner spots have been claimed.

items.title: A place on the Founding Partner waitlist, free
items.body: You pay nothing to join. The discount applies only when we open paid Basic with M2 — and only if you choose to subscribe.

items.title: Discount on Basic at M2
items.body: Basic (M1+M2) covers design, cut lists, sheet nesting, labels and client quotes. Founding Partners pay less than list price. Anyone who comes later, without a waitlist place, pays full list. We announce the amounts when we're ready.

items.title: A say in what we build
items.body: Tell us what's missing in your workshop, and your ideas go straight into the roadmap.

items.title: Your name, as a Founding Partner
items.body: You're listed among the people who helped build Mobilcab.

items.title: Private feedback group
items.body: Talk directly with the founders and the other Founding Partners.

items.title: Personal notice when payment opens
items.body: We contact you when paid Basic (M2) is ready, with list price and your discount — before the FP offer closes.

offer.title: The offer now
offer.detail: When we ship M2 and open paid Basic, people on the Founding Partner waitlist can buy at a discount. Anyone who wants the paid plan later pays full list price. Waitlist places are limited; we'll say when we close sign-ups.
offer.noPayment: Joining doesn't commit you to anything. If you don't want to pay when Basic opens, you decline — and that's it.

ai.title: What Basic doesn't include
ai.body: Said plainly: paid Basic (at M2) is for the workshop — design, cut lists, nesting, labels, quotes. It does not include CNC export (a later stage) or recurring AI. AI and CNC will have their own offers, announced in time.
